s.note: the Kiwi party favourite at the animal costume party
s.how: Bring a pot of water to a simmer, add 500g cocktail frankfurts and heat for 5 minutes without boiling so the skins don't split. Drain, pile into a bowl with toothpicks and serve with 125ml tomato sauce for dipping.

s.note: the dip at every New Zealand party
s.how: Stir 1 packet French onion soup mix into 300ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp lemon juice. Chill for at least 1 hour until thick, stirring once. Serve in a bowl surrounded by 200g salted potato chips for dipping.

m.note: Lily's job at the burger counter
m.how: Shape 600g beef mince into 4 patties and fry 4 minutes a side, adding a slice of tasty cheese at the end. Toast 4 buns and build with lettuce, tomato, 4 slices tinned beetroot, the patty and tomato sauce.

w.how: Beat 200g butter with 75g sugar, then mix in 175g flour, 25g cocoa and 50g cornflakes. Roll into 16 balls, flatten slightly and bake at 180C for 15 minutes. Cool, ice with 150g icing sugar mixed with 1 tbsp cocoa and water, and top each with a walnut half.

d.note: the fizzy drink at the party
d.how: Simmer 100g caster sugar with 100ml water and the zest of 2 lemons until dissolved, cool and add the juice of 4 lemons. Pour 50ml into each of 4 glasses with ice and top with 200ml soda water.
